title: C-O4 v4: `orchestrator serve` — bearer-authed HTTP API over goals (final spec; folds in spec reviews T-0140, T-0143, T-0146; supersedes T-0144)
spec:
Why: the kgpt `modules/orchestrator` (Phase C, kgpt side) forwards start_goal/goal_status/list_goals/cancel_goal to a per-user endpoint; this is that endpoint, running in the executor container on the home network. Spec round 4 folds in spec reviews T-0140, T-0143 and T-0146; dispatched without a further spec review by Planner decision. Scope is 6 files by Planner decision: the requester field belongs in goals.py with its record, and README waits for the C-O5 runbook.

CONTRACT WITH goals.py (read orchestrator/goals.py on goal/T-0073 first): goals.status(repo_path, goal_id=None) returns a LIST of entry dicts (one per record, filtered to goal_id when given; empty list when unknown); goals.list_goals(repo_path) returns the same list shape; goals.stop(repo_path, goal_id) returns {"error": "unknown goal"} for an unknown id, else a dict with the record's status; goals.start(...) returns {"launched": bool, ...} with "reason" when false. Entry dicts carry goal_id, record_status, planner_alive, requester and the fields _status_entry builds. If any of this differs from the code you read, follow the code and say so in the summary.

goals.py (small, additive): start(repo_path, goal_text, account_id="A", reinstall=False, requester=None) stores `requester` (string or None) on the goals.json record; _status_entry()/status()/list_goals() return it. Nothing else in goals.py changes. tests/test_goals.py: one test that start() with requester="alice" records it and status() returns it.

serve.py with starlette (import from the mcp dependency tree; if starlette or uvicorn is not importable, exit at startup with one line; do not add a dependency). `from . import goals` and calls through the module attribute (goals.start etc.), never `from .goals import start`. All route handlers are plain `def` (not async). Every goal entry in a response carries "repo": <slug> added by serve.py. repos.toml: `.orchestrator/repos.toml` maps slug → {path, git_url?}; "path missing" below means THE DIRECTORY DOES NOT EXIST ON DISK (os.path.isdir(path) is false), never that the key is absent; an entry without a path key is a 500-free config error: 404 {"reason": "repo not configured"}.
Per-slug lock: fcntl flock on <ORCH_WORK>/.locks/<slug>.lock (mkdir -p; ORCH_WORK env, default /work), mirroring goals.py's _with_goals_lock pattern; POST /goals holds it across the whole clone-check + running-check + goals.start sequence so two concurrent starts for one slug serialize (T-0146 risk 6).
Routes:
- GET /healthz (no auth) → 200 {"status": "ok"}.
- POST /goals body {repo, goal, requester?, account?}: 400 {"reason": ...} when repo or goal is missing, goal is empty/whitespace, or requester/account present and not a string; 404 {"reason": "unknown repo"} for an unknown slug. Under the per-slug lock: if the directory is missing and git_url is set → `subprocess.run(["git", "clone", git_url, path], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=CLONE_TIMEOUT_S)` with CLONE_TIMEOUT_S = int(env ORCH_CLONE_TIMEOUT_S or 300); TimeoutExpired → 504 {"reason": "clone timed out"}; non-zero → 502 {"reason": "clone failed"} and the stderr goes ONLY to the server log after redaction (regex replace `://[^/@\s]+@` with `://***@`), never into the response body (T-0146 risk 3); directory missing and no git_url → 404 {"reason": "repo path missing and no git_url"}. Then goals.list_goals(path): any entry with record_status == "running" and planner_alive True → 409 {"reason": "goal already running", "goal_id": <id>}. Then goals.start(path, goal, account_id=body.get("account", "A"), requester=body.get("requester")); launched true → 201 {goal_id, repo: slug, status: "running", requester}; launched false → 422 {"reason": r["reason"]}. Never a 500 for an expected refusal.
- GET /goals[?repo=slug] → 200 {"goals": [entries]} from goals.list_goals(path) per configured repo (all repos when no filter; 404 unknown slug), each entry with "repo": slug.
- GET /goals/{repo}/{goal_id} → entries = goals.status(path, goal_id); empty → 404 {"reason": "unknown goal"}; else 200 with the single entry dict plus "repo": slug (T-0146 risk 1).
- POST /goals/{repo}/{goal_id}/cancel → goals.stop(path, goal_id); {"error": "unknown goal"} → 404; else 200 {goal_id, repo: slug, status: "stopped"}.
Auth: every route except /healthz requires `Authorization: Bearer <ORCH_SERVICE_TOKEN>` (env; the server refuses to start with one line and non-zero exit when unset), compared with hmac.compare_digest; 401 {"reason": "unauthorized"} otherwise. The token is never stored, logged or echoed; access log lines contain method, path, status only.
cli.py: `serve [--host 127.0.0.1] [--port 8090]` runs uvicorn with the app. `.orchestrator/repos.toml.example` with one commented entry showing slug, path, git_url.

Tests tests/test_serve.py with starlette's TestClient and orchestrator.goals.start/list_goals/status/stop patched via unittest.mock.patch (no real git, no Popen; ORCH_WORK pointed at a temp dir): healthz_no_auth, rejects_missing_or_wrong_bearer, unknown_repo_404, empty_goal_400, bad_requester_type_400, start_returns_goal_id_and_requester (201; start called with requester and account kwargs; response repo == slug), start_refusal_422, second_start_409_while_running (start NOT called), list_entries_carry_slug, get_goal_returns_single_entry_200, get_goal_unknown_404 (status returns []), clone_runs_under_lock_once_with_timeout (directory missing + git_url set; subprocess.run patched: called once with an argv list starting ["git", "clone"] and a timeout kwarg; lock file exists under ORCH_WORK/.locks), clone_failure_502_does_not_echo_stderr (patched run returns rc 1 with stderr containing "https://user:SECRET@host"; body has no "SECRET"), clone_timeout_504, cancel_marks_stopped, cancel_unknown_404, handlers_are_sync, serve_imports_goals_as_module (serve.goals is orchestrator.goals). No new dependency; finish with summary, files changed, failures-only test output; commit on the task branch when green.
acceptance: tests/test_serve.py has the eighteen named tests, green; tests/test_goals.py gains the requester test, green
goals.start accepts requester and status()/list_goals() return it; no other goals.py change (diff)

serve.py calls goals.* through the module attribute; every handler is a plain def; single-goal GET returns one entry or 404 from an empty status() list; every start() refusal maps to 422; 409 comes from list_goals; every goal entry carries repo = slug; requester/account validated as strings or 400

First-use clone runs under a per-slug flock that also spans the running-check and start(), as an argv list with a timeout; clone stderr never reaches a response body and is redacted in the log; timeout → 504
`uv run orchestrator serve` without ORCH_SERVICE_TOKEN exits non-zero with one line; no route logs, stores or echoes the bearer
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green; no new dependency; only the six scoped files change; committed on the task branch

result.summary:
Committed on `task/T-0147`.

## Summary

Implemented the per-user goal HTTP endpoint (`orchestrator/serve.py`) that kgpt's `modules/orchestrator` forwards to, plus the `requester` field threaded through `goals.py`.

- **`orchestrator/goals.py`**: `start()` gained a `requester=None` kwarg, stored on the goal record; `_status_entry()` returns it. Nothing else changed (diff is 2 one-line additions).
- **`orchestrator/serve.py`** (new): starlette app, all route handlers plain `def`. Bearer auth via `hmac.compare_digest` on every route but `/healthz`; per-slug `flock` under `<ORCH_WORK>/.locks/<slug>.lock` spans the clone-check, running-check, and `goals.start` call; clone stderr is regex-redacted and only ever logged, never returned in a response; every start refusal maps to 422, running-conflict to 409, unknown/misconfigured repo to 404 (never 500). `goals` is imported and called as a module (`from . import goals`), never via `from .goals import ...`, so `mock.patch("orchestrator.goals.x")` reaches serve.py's calls. Repo config comes from `.orchestrator/repos.toml` (path overridable via `ORCH_REPOS_TOML` for tests).
- **`orchestrator/cli.py`**: added `serve [--host] [--port]`, delegating to `serve.main()`, which exits non-zero with one line if `ORCH_SERVICE_TOKEN` is unset.
- **`.orchestrator/repos.toml.example`**: one commented slug/path/git_url entry.
- **Tests**: `tests/test_serve.py` has all 18 named tests, green. `tests/test_goals.py` gained `test_start_records_requester_and_status_returns_it`.

One implementation detail not pinned by the spec: reading the POST body in a sync handler needs `anyio.from_thread.run(request.body)` (anyio ships as a starlette/uvicorn transitive dependency already in the lockfile — no new dependency added).

Full suite: `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` → 175 tests, OK. `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` → exit 0. Only the six scoped files changed; committed on `task/T-0147` (be42500).
